description: Find and fix a look-ahead bias in an SMA crossover strategy where positions use today's signal without shifting, causing the strategy to act on information not yet available.
agent_prompt: Read the buggy strategy at /workspace/student_code/lookahead.py. It runs an SMA crossover on /workspace/data/AAPL_2018_2024.csv but contains a look-ahead bias: Position is assigned directly from Signal without a one-bar shift, so the strategy trades using information from the current bar's close. (1) Identify the bug and write a one-paragraph explanation to /workspace/output/diagnosis.md describing why this is look-ahead and how the fix changes temporal alignment. (2) Produce a fixed version at /workspace/output/lookahead_fixed.py with shift(1) applied to Position. (3) Run both the buggy and fixed versions and write /workspace/output/comparison.json with keys buggy_total_return, fixed_total_return, buggy_sharpe, fixed_sharpe, return_drop_pct (the fix should reduce returns — the drop magnitude proves the bias was real).

required_capabilities: Read and understand signal generation code
Identify the temporal alignment issue (no shift on position)
Explain why this constitutes look-ahead bias
Apply shift(1) to remove the bias
Verify quantitatively that returns drop after the fix
